verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents keyboard shortcuts in a dedicated help article, and one hands-on user reports it was 'a ton faster' than ProtonMail. JMAP's claims of single-roundtrip sync support responsiveness, though these are protocol-level, not UI-level. missing for 10: any evidence of a command palette, detail showing the shortcuts are comprehensive enough to do everything from the keyboard, and stronger independent corroboration of UI speed.
